race.comment: KARREN (5) is a promising mare who looks very well placed. She beat Sass Appeal on debut in town which has turned out to be very good form then started favourite and just found one better at Geelong first up. The winner there is a pretty good horse in its own right and she should be fitter with every chance from the gate. MEDIA PUPPET (2) was a $21 chance on debut but looked good winning dominantly at Seymour and can go on with it. SHAPENAPIT (9) is going well and looks a solid each way chance. LYGON STREET LUIGI (4) is resuming from a lay-off. Progressing well including a win in a Flemington jump-out. Place hope fresh.
